digest.component_or_area: fsck module architecture and store layer
propositions: Three pure filesystem primitives (_resolve_tracker_git_dir, _ticket_dirs, _dir_is_archived) are currently defined in fsck_repair.py but should be moved to gitutil.py because they have no repair-specific logic and are used by seven production modules including store-layer code.

Moving the primitives to gitutil.py maintains its declared stdlib-only leaf property: the moved functions require only os or function-local imports of non-stdlib rebar modules, and all consumers already import from _store, so no circular dependency is introduced.

The fsck.py and fsck_repair.py modules must maintain backward-compatible re-export surfaces for the moved primitives so that existing test patches binding them as module attributes continue to work without modification.

All three primitives must be relocated from fsck_repair.py (686 LOC) to gitutil.py (614 LOC) while keeping both modules under the 800-LOC hard cap and maintaining identical function bodies and behavior.
